pages.title: Cherenkov Lattice
pages.text: Diamond struts and threads of Cherenkov quartz, wound around a core of netherite scrap. The quartz glows the same blue that charged particles give off when they outrun light in water. It is a frame for a crystal that cannot hold itself together, rigid and faintly luminous.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed scaffolding strong enough to pin a superposition in place. Diamond for rigidity, netherite for weight and Cherenkov quartz to keep the light moving gave me a frame that would not flinch.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Crystalline Matrix Ingot, Form of the Self.
